versos.grego: γίνεσθε οὖν μιμηταὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὡς τέκνα ἀγαπητά,

controles.web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
controles.kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
controles.livre: Portanto, sede imitadores de Deus, como filhos amados;

versos.grego: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ Θεῷ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας.

controles.web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
controles.kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
controles.livre: e andai em amor, como também Cristo vos amou, e se entregou por nós como oferta e sacrifício de cheiro suave a Deus.

versos.grego: Πορνεία δὲ καὶ ἀκαθαρσία πᾶσα ἢ πλεονεξία μηδὲ ὀνομαζέσθω ἐν ὑμῖν, καθὼς πρέπει ἁγίοις,

controles.web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
controles.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
controles.livre: Mas o pecado sexual, e toda impureza ou cobiça, nem mesmo se nomeie entre vós, como convém a santos;

versos.grego: καὶ αἰσχρότης καὶ μωρολογία ἢ εὐτραπελία, ἃ οὐκ ἀνῆκεν, ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εὐχαριστία.

controles.web: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.
controles.kjv: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
controles.livre: nem imoralidades, nem palavras tolas, nem escárnios, que não convêm; em vez disso, atos de gratidão.

versos.grego: τοῦτο γὰρ ἴστε γινώσκοντες, ὅτι πᾶς πόρνος ἢ ἀκάθαρτος ἢ πλεονέκτης, ὅ ἐστιν εἰδωλολάτρης, οὐκ ἔχει κληρονομίαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
controles.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
controles.livre: Pois sabeis disto, que nenhum pecador no sexo, ou impuro, ou ganancioso, que é idólatra, tem herança no reino de Cristo e de Deus.

versos.grego: Μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς ἀπατάτω κενοῖς λόγοις· διὰ ταῦτα γὰρ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας.

controles.web: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
controles.kjv: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
controles.livre: Ninguém vos engane com palavras vazias; pois por essas coisas a ira de Deus vem sobre os filhos da desobediência.

versos.grego: μὴ οὖν γίνεσθε συνμέτοχοι αὐτῶν·

controles.web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
controles.kjv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
controles.livre: Portanto não sejais parceiros deles.

versos.grego: ἦτε γάρ ποτε σκότος, νῦν δὲ φῶς ἐν Κυρίῳ· ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς περιπατεῖτε,

controles.web: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
controles.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
controles.livre: Pois antes vós éreis trevas, mas agora sois luz no Senhor; andai como filhos da luz

versos.grego: —ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ,

controles.web: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
controles.kjv: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
controles.livre: (porque o fruto da luz  consiste em toda bondade, justiça, e verdade),

versos.grego: —δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
controles.kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
controles.livre: buscando descobrir o que agrada ao Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ συνκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἀκάρποις τοῦ σκότους, μᾶλλον δὲ καὶ ἐλέγχετε,

controles.web: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
controles.kjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
controles.livre: E não participeis das obras infrutíferas das trevas, pelo contrário, reprovai-as.

versos.grego: τὰ γὰρ κρυφῇ γινόμενα ὑπ’ αὐτῶν αἰσχρόν ἐστιν καὶ λέγειν·

controles.web: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.
controles.kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
controles.livre: pois é vergonhoso até dizer o que eles fazem em segredo.

versos.grego: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται· πᾶν γὰρ τὸ φανερούμενον φῶς ἐστιν.

controles.web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
controles.kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
controles.livre: Mas todas essas coisas, quando são reprovadas, tornam-se visíveis pela luz, porque tudo o que se se torna visível é luz.

versos.grego: διὸ λέγει Ἔγειρε, ὁ καθεύδων, καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἐπιφαύσει σοι ὁ Χριστός.

controles.web: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
controles.livre: Por isso se diz: Desperta tu, que dormes, e levanta-te dos mortos, e Cristo te iluminará.

versos.grego: Βλέπετε οὖν ἀκριβῶς πῶς περιπατεῖτε, μὴ ὡς ἄσοφοι ἀλλ’ ὡς σοφοί,

controles.web: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;
controles.kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
controles.livre: Portanto vede cuidadosamente como vos conduzis,  não como tolos, mas sim como sábios;

versos.grego: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρόν, ὅτι αἱ ἡμέραι πονηραί εἰσιν.

controles.web: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
controles.kjv: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
controles.livre: aproveitai o tempo, porque os dias são maus.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο μὴ γίνεσθε ἄφρονες, ἀλλὰ συνίετε τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
controles.kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
controles.livre: Por isso, não sejais imprudentes, mas entendei qual é a vontade do Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ μεθύσκεσθε οἴνῳ, ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἀσωτία, ἀλλὰ πληροῦσθε ἐν Πνεύματι,

controles.web: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
controles.kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
controles.livre: E não fiqueis bêbados com vinho, em que há devassidão, mas enchei-vos do Espírito;

versos.grego: λαλοῦντες ἑαυτοῖς ψαλμοῖς καὶ ὕμνοις καὶ ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς, ᾄδοντες καὶ ψάλλοντες τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
controles.kjv: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
controles.livre: falando entre vós com salmos, hinos e cânticos espirituais; cantando e louvando ao Senhor no vosso coração;

versos.grego: εὐχαριστοῦντες πάντοτε ὑπὲρ πάντων ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρί,

controles.web: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;
controles.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
controles.livre: agradecendo sempre por tudo a Deus, o Pai, no nome do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;

versos.grego: ὑποτασσόμενοι ἀλλήλοις ἐν φόβῳ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.
controles.kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
controles.livre: sujeitando-vos uns aos outros no temor a Cristo.

versos.grego: Αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
controles.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Mulheres, sujeitai-vos aos vossos próprios maridos, assim como ao Senhor;

versos.grego: ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς ὡς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, αὐτὸς σωτὴρ τοῦ σώματος.

controles.web: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
controles.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
controles.livre: porque o marido é o cabeça da mulher, como também Cristo é o cabeça da Igreja, e ele é o salvador do corpo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ὡς ἡ ἐκκλησία ὑποτάσσεται τῷ Χριστῷ, οὕτως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐν παντί.

controles.web: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
controles.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
controles.livre: Mas, assim como a Igreja está sujeita a Cristo, assim também as mulheres estejam em tudo sujeitas aos maridos.

versos.grego: Οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἑαυτὸν παρέδωκεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς,

controles.web: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
controles.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
controles.livre: Maridos, amai as vossas próprias esposas, assim como também Cristo amou a Igreja, e se entregou por ela;

versos.grego: ἵνα αὐτὴν ἁγιάσῃ καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι,

controles.web: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,
controles.kjv: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
controles.livre: a fim de a santificar, havendo a purificado com a lavagem com água, pela palavra,

versos.grego: ἵνα παραστήσῃ αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος.

controles.web: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without defect.
controles.kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
controles.livre: a fim de apresentar a si mesmo uma igreja gloriosa, sem mancha, nem ruga, nem algo semelhante; mas sim, santa e irrepreensível.

versos.grego: οὕτως ὀφείλουσιν καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα. ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἑαυτὸν ἀγαπᾷ·

controles.web: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
controles.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
controles.livre: Assim os maridos devem amar as suas próprias esposas como os seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua esposa, ama a si mesmo;

versos.grego: οὐδεὶς γάρ ποτε τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σάρκα ἐμίσησεν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν,

controles.web: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;
controles.kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
controles.livre: pois ninguém jamais odiou a sua própria carne; mas a alimenta e sustenta, assim como também Cristo à Igreja.

versos.grego: ὅτι μέλη ἐσμὲν τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
controles.kjv: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
controles.livre: pois somos membros de seu corpo.

versos.grego: ἀντὶ τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.

controles.web: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.”
controles.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
controles.livre: Por isso o homem deixará oseu pai e a sua mãe, e se ajuntará com a sua mulher; e os dois serão uma só carne.

versos.grego: τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο μέγα ἐστίν, ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν.

controles.web: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.
controles.kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
controles.livre: Esse é um grande mistério, mas estou dizendo quanto a Cristo e à Igreja.

versos.grego: πλὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς οἱ καθ’ ἕνα ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ὡς ἑαυτόν, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα.

controles.web: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
controles.livre: Assim também vós, cada um individualmente, ame a sua própria esposa como a si mesmo, e a mulher respeite o marido.
